# Contributing

Start with the [canonical contributing guide](../docs/src/contributing.md). It covers local builds,
focused tests and feature flags, fixtures, generated artifacts, documentation, and recovery evidence.

Open a pull request from a short-lived feature branch after completing the checks that apply to the
change. Keep the pull request focused and describe the fixture, evidence, or user-visible behavior
that establishes the claim.

Before a pull request can merge, read the [Disrobe Contributor Assignment and License
Agreement](../CONTRIBUTING-LICENSE.md), which implements Section 6 of the [LICENSE](../LICENSE).
Post its complete acceptance statement as a comment from the account that authored the commits it
covers. Add a fresh acceptance after substantive new commits.

Do not report vulnerabilities in a public issue. Use the [private security advisory
channel](https://github.com/1-3-7/disrobe/security/advisories/new) and follow the
[security policy](../SECURITY.md).
